newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa - H1 passenger numbers up 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa - H1 passenger numbers up 5.7 pct.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Tuesday that passenger numbers in the first half of 1997 rose 5.7 percent to 20.8 million from 19.682 million in the same period last year.
Lufthansa said that passenger load factor in the first half was 71.7 percent versus 67.6 percent last time.
Cargo and post fell slightly in the first half to 812,400 tonnes compared to 815,700 tonnes
The main rise in passenger numbers came from Lufthansa's CityLine service, where passenger numbers grew 24.2 percent to 1.8 million.
Around 3.2 million passengers flew on Lufthansa's holiday airline subsidiary, Condor, an increase of 10.7 percent.
Lufthansa said that the number of flights in the first six months grew 6.5 percent to around 309,000. This related chiefly to more flights at Lufthansa Cargo and Lufthansa CityLine.
Capacity increased by around two percentage points to 70.3 percent.
